content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The Claim 1 finding rests on Complainant not reporting the slurs before EEO contact, yet CAPT recalled homophobic slurs being mentioned in the Threat Assessment Committee report; that report and LT2's photographs were never obtained, so the path from evidence to conclusion cannot be traced."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Most characterizations are attributed to named witnesses (Complainant, CAPT, HRM, CO1, CO2, LT1, LT2), but key sources referenced in testimony are not in the file: the TAC report, the LT2 photographs, CO1's contemporaneous memo, and Acting HRM, who convened the TAC and held its documentation."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Events are largely dated from November 17, 2022 through August 3, 2023, but the sequence has inconsistencies, including whether COP was paid or denied after OWCP's January 9 denial, CAPT's claim of no contact since January 2 despite his February 9 request, and the timing of the TAC's corrective actions."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The final decision names no reviewer and gives a single-sentence rationale per claim; it does not address the agency's response to co-worker harassment or CAPT's knowledge of the December 29, 2022 EEO contact, and it relies only on HRM's denial of knowledge until September 2023."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"With the TAC report, photographs, and Acting HRM testimony missing, and the decision's reasoning contradicted by record testimony, an independent reviewer cannot assess whether the conclusions are supported without further development of the record."}}}
